conclusion: No fix in current upstream release/master or open PR for the three observed issues. Current master is behaviorally identical for evaluated FUSE and date parser. Rebuilding master would not change those paths.
recommendation: Retain AFT + sync candidate. Do not change NFS to conceal directory or timestamp semantics. Original-driver-only use must explicitly accept unsupported timestamp preservation and unresolved failed-directory cache bug; otherwise an upstream fix or explicitly authorized minimal driver change is necessary. Matching process TZ may correct this device’s no-zone dates but cannot implement timestamp preservation.
changes: Only ignored investigation records; production and upstream driver sources unchanged.
